resultset.statement: -- Query under test: derived table has an explicit utf8mb4 introducer on a -- string literal in its SELECT list; the outer WHERE references the derived -- column. Pushdown of "d.tag = 'alpha'" into the derived table triggers -- clone_expression() on the derived expression containing the Item_string. SELECT d.id, d.tag FROM ( SELECT id, _utf8mb4'alpha' AS tag FROM wf_dcp_inner ) AS d JOIN wf_dcp_outer AS o ON o.id = d.id WHERE d.tag = _utf8mb4'alpha' ORDER BY d.id
SELECT d.id, d.tag FROM ( SELECT id, _utf8mb4'alpha' AS tag FROM wf_dcp_inner ) AS d JOIN wf_dcp_outer AS o ON o.id = d.id WHERE d.tag = _utf8mb4'alpha' ORDER BY d.id
